_readme: Accessibility-regression baseline for the axe (WCAG 2.1 AA) e2e gate in a11y.spec.ts. The gate audits the whole page — including the app's own shell chrome (hamburger button, <nav> wrapper) — and tolerates only the specific @dhis2/ui vendor NODES listed in `ignored`, matched by axe rule id + a distinctive substring of the node's target selector. Per-node (not per-rule) on purpose: it never silences a rule for future markup, so a new app-introduced violation — even the same rule on a different element — still fails. Add an entry only for a genuinely-unfixable @dhis2/ui node, and revisit on each @dhis2/ui upgrade.
